error_connection_limit_body: Your IPTV provider says the maximum number of simultaneous streams is reached. Another device may still be using the account, or has just stopped: the slot is usually freed within a few minutes.
error_access_denied_body: The provider refused this stream: expired subscription, blocked IP address or restricted content.
error_not_found_body: This content no longer exists or is no longer available from your provider.
error_server_title: The provider's server is not responding
error_server_body: Your provider's server is having trouble. Retrying automatically.
error_network_body: The stream is not responding. Check your internet connection.
error_unsupported_format_body: This content uses a format ({{detail}}) the player cannot decode on this device.
error_device_too_slow_title: This source is too demanding for this device
error_device_too_slow_body: This device cannot play this source smoothly ({{detail}}). Try another version of this content if available, for example 1080p or HDR10.
error_missing_credentials_body: Your IPTV provider credentials could not be read on this device. Try again; if the problem persists, sign in to your provider again from the settings.
error_invalid_stream_body: The address of this content could not be built: your provider does not supply the information needed to play it.
error_tls_unavailable_body: This device could not read its security certificates: this encrypted (HTTPS) stream was not opened, so your credentials are not exposed. Try again; if the problem persists, restart the app.
error_engine_stopped_body: The video player stopped unexpectedly. Try again to resume playback, or close the player.
error_unknown_body: The stream could not be played.
error_retry_exhausted: Still unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
error_device_too_slow_known: Already seen on this device with this kind of video: you are warned from the start.
